sentence: This project builds a deep learning tool that monitors animal behavior and brain electrical activity to study how groups sleep.
This project builds methods that use gravitational waves from colliding black holes to test whether General Relativity remains valid.
This project builds crystals from engineered protein, DNA and RNA building blocks and tests whether molecular building blocks can be substituted.
This project builds a digital system that simulates the human brain to predict Alzheimer's disease and understand cognitive decline.
This project builds a wireless network system that uses radio measurements and on-device perception to support extended reality.
This project studies how the bridge helix of two proteins helps them cut DNA only at the right places.
This project studies the history of two groups of invasive slugs and tries to find out what helped them spread rapidly.
This project builds an augmented reality system for engineering learning and tests whether it leads to knowledge gain on engineering topics.
This project develops genomic tools in painted turtle cells to study gene function and adaptive responses to climate change.
This project develops techniques to protect the security and privacy of data in computing systems used for research.
This project improves measurements of what the highest-energy particles ever observed are made of and where they come from.
This project builds computer vision models that keep recognizing what they see even as the visual world changes.
This project uses computational methods and experiments to understand how iron-based catalysts control chemical reactions.
This project builds a software library that makes reading data faster when training AI models.
This project holds workshops and a panel on using lab automation to overcome bottlenecks in plant bioengineering.
This project builds a computer system that uses deep learning to find small defects in medical devices during manufacturing.
This project compares how humans and large language models represent design concepts, using brain activity, to build AI tools that fit how designers think.
